name: fitcoach-ai-proxy
description: AI proxy (Cloudflare Worker) for the FitCoach AI white-label fitness app

scripts.secrets: echo 'wrangler secret put APP_TOKEN; затем ключ провайдера: wrangler secret put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (anthropic) или wrangler secret put AI_API_KEY (openai); для повара на своей модели — wrangler secret put CHEF_API_KEY'
